# Agent Instructions

The rules for this repository live in [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md). Read that file first, follow it exactly, and do not duplicate its rules here.

## Chat onboarding

A fresh clone explains itself: [docs/ONBOARDING-CHAT.md](docs/ONBOARDING-CHAT.md)
(ru [docs/ONBOARDING-CHAT.ru.md](docs/ONBOARDING-CHAT.ru.md), zh
[docs/ONBOARDING-CHAT.zh.md](docs/ONBOARDING-CHAT.zh.md)). If you just opened this repository,
go there and walk the person through the steps instead of installing anything silently.
